# dirvec session 3: pre-registered retest on fresh directories

Hypothesis block copied verbatim from BRIEF.md, session 3, before the first eval run.

## Hypothesis (fixed now, do not edit after the first eval run)
H: a pooled centroid (a) loses queries whose modality is the minority in their directory;
per-modality k-reps (c) recover them.
Primary cells, recall@5, leave-one-out, same method as session 2:
  1. image queries in [0,.2) and [.2,.5) directories
  2. text-like queries (text, table, pdf_text, other) in [.5,.8) and [.8,1] directories
Kill: if the paired 95% bootstrap interval (1000 resamples over directories) of c - a does not
exclude zero in both pooled primary cells, H is dead. Report it plainly either way.
Secondary, reported, no kill: b - a in the same cells; d - c everywhere; vectors per directory
for a, b, c, d.

## Verdict

**H survives.** Paired 95% interval of c - a on recall@5, 1000 resamples over directories:
cell 1 (image queries in [0,.2) and [.2,.5)): a 0.582, c 0.761, c - a +0.179 [+0.115, +0.251],
414 queries over 183 directories. Cell 2 (text-like queries in [.5,.8) and [.8,1]): a 0.527,
c 0.726, c - a +0.200 [+0.135, +0.270], 471 queries over 194 directories. Both exclude zero.
Secondary: b - a is the same size (+0.184, +0.195). d - c is small everywhere; d is not beaten.

## Setup

400 fresh Zenodo directories (seed 20261001, none from session 1), 4,891 files; 4,101 ground-truth
queries, 4,041 with a vector (60 dropped: 42 other, 17 table (16 with an .xls extension that are
really tab-separated text and fail xlrd, 1 empty), 1 image of 16x16 px). jina-embeddings-v4, same revision,
same input rules, query-side text, bfloat16, same venv. All 400 directories ranked.
One change to embed.py: images below 28 px are skipped and counted (the processor refuses them).

## Tables (output of `python scripts/eval.py --model jina-embeddings-v4 --emb jina-embeddings-v4_s3 --manifest data/manifest_s3.jsonl --dirs data/dirs_s3.jsonl --gt data/gt_structural_s3.jsonl --criterion s3`)

Model: jina-embeddings-v4. Queries: 4041 over 400 directories; 400 directories ranked (random recall@k = k/400). Queries dropped for lack of a vector: 60 {'table': 17, 'other': 42, 'image': 1}.

Mean representative vectors per directory: a 1.00, b 2.58, c 5.39, d 12.08.
